about: Persistent severe anxiety prevents independent shopping and reduces quality of life, and there is no SSRI, SNRI or pregabalin supply.
Persistent severe anxiety is recorded, and sertraline (Zoloft) is supplied every month through the last six months, so nothing is missing.
SSRIs are contraindicated and the record confirms duloxetine was supplied for the persistent severe anxiety that limits independent shopping and reduces quality of life.
Pregabalin is supplied only for neuropathic pain, so it does not treat the recorded severe anxiety even though SSRI suitability is unknown.
An SSRI is suitable, so the duloxetine supply with no recorded indication does not clear the omission for the recorded severe anxiety.
